scope: Proposition 4.4 (Uniform cold control) of the manuscript “Nonuniqueness for the periodic hard-sphere Boltzmann equation” (preprints/Nonuniqueness-for-the-periodic-hard-sphere-Boltzmann-equation-September-23-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 363 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 9cf0253f6b105302), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 22. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: There is a constant L, depending on the fixed parameters, such that after imposing the additional condition Ld0s9 ≤ 1, (4.10) the following statements hold at every time of existence of the finite approximation in 0 ≤ t ≤ T. (i) For every retained label i = (j, σ, n), 0 ≤ ci ≤ fi + εjmi, εj = Ldsj /sj. (4.11) (ii) At each spatial point call the unique label with x ∈ Oi(t), if one exists and is retained, the main label. Let cmain be that color, or zero, and set e = c − cmain. For every A ≥ 0, 0 ≤ e(t, x, v) ≤ CAtA e−4|v|2 . (4.12) The upper bound remains valid after restricting the escaped sum to any subset of its labels. (iii) If the main label has scale s, its velocity measure is bounded by a fixed multiple of (t + s)−1 times a sum of admissible probability sheets from Lemma 3.4. Its free-core contribution has the exact parameterization (4.16) below. The remainder has the smaller velocity-mass coefficient Cds/s2. In particular, for every fixed k ≥ 0, Z R3 ⟨v⟩k cmain dv ≤ Ck t + s , Z |v|>R ⟨v⟩k cmain dv ≤ Cke−ckR2 t + s (R ≥ 3). (4.13) (iv) For the mixed-cold source in the hot equation, X i,j∈IN i̸=j Pb (ci, cj)(t, x, v) ≤ CAtA−1 H(v) (t > 0) (4.14) for every A ≥ 0, with constants uniform in N and b.
